title: Create named styles
introduction: StyleSheet.create groups styles under names. Your task: Change the title fontSize to 28.
learningObjectives: Explain the example for create named styles

blocks.text: StyleSheet.create groups styles under names. Native style properties use JavaScript names such as backgroundColor.
Use a current Expo project with React Native. Put examples in App.jsx. Run the project with Expo on a supported device or emulator. Native components do not run in this website's HTML playground.

items: `StyleSheet.create` groups named React Native styles using JavaScript property names and native values.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Native style values are not CSS strings with px. Use numeric values where the native style expects a number.
